records.name: Greymanes
records.summary: Kliff's mercenary company and the protectors of Pailune, all but destroyed in the opening attack.
records.body: Survivors are found one by one through the main story. Greymane commissions are short repeatable tasks that pay a flat reward and refresh daily.

reputation.notes: Faction reputation follows the five-tier scale; Alliance unlocks faction vendors, materials and restricted areas. Reported, not yet checked in-game.

records.name: Black Bears
records.summary: Myurdin's hostile faction, responsible for the attack on the Greymane camp.
